## Checklist

- [ ] Unit tests added for the happy path, the offline path and one failure path
- [ ] E2E scenario file added or updated if user-visible behaviour changed
- [ ] Contract change? The other developer has approved it and the version is bumped
- [ ] Anything that sends, deletes or overwrites still needs confirmation
- [ ] No secrets, no real documents, no network calls in unit tests
- [ ] The activity log shows the action in plain language
- [ ] docs/DECISIONS.md updated if a significant choice was made
